`Core\Request::jsonAs`, `method`, `mount`, `scheme` and `path` owe nothing. `scheme` and
`path` each have `about.md`, three examples, an attack and a bench declaring
`allocations 1` and `calls 0` (both measured at 1.00 allocations per read). Each also has a
Rust test carrying `covers:`. `path`'s test (`path_answers_the_remainder_the_carrier_holds_as_it_arrived`)
is new, because no Rust test called the member before.

`dossier-core-request-2-2` still fails on five members: `query`, `queryAs`, `post`,
`postAs` and `route`. Each owes examples, an attack and a bench, and most owe a `covers:`
marker on a Rust test. `query_as_reads_the_query_string_the_same_way` and the
`post_as_*` tests (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs:6879`, `:6822`) are the Rust tests
to mark for `queryAs` and `postAs`.

A `.nvsr` names the query with `--GET--` and a urlencoded body with `--POST--`
(`crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs`'s module doc). `--PATH--` is the path after the mount
prefix was removed.
